defmodule SecureAudit do
  @moduledoc "Audit logging service with input sanitization"

  require Logger

  defmodule Sanitizer do
    @max_length 256

    @doc "Sanitizes user input for safe log inclusion"
    def clean(input) when is_binary(input) do
      input
      |> String.slice(0, @max_length)
      |> remove_dangerous_chars()
    end

    def clean(input), do: clean(inspect(input))

    defp remove_dangerous_chars(str) do
      str
      |> String.replace("\r\n", " ")
      |> String.replace("\r", " ")
      |> String.replace("\n", " ")
    end
  end

  defmodule EventStore do
    use GenServer

    def start_link(opts \\ []) do
      GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
    end

    def init(_opts) do
      {:ok, %{events: [], flush_ref: nil}}
    end

    def record_event(user_id, action, metadata \\ %{}) do
      GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:record, user_id, action, metadata})
    end

    def flush do
      GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :flush)
    end

    def handle_cast({:record, user_id, action, metadata}, state) do
      sanitized_event = %{
        user_id: SecureAudit.Sanitizer.clean(user_id),
        action: SecureAudit.Sanitizer.clean(action),
        metadata: sanitize_metadata(metadata),
        timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()
      }

      new_state = %{state | events: [sanitized_event | state.events]}

      new_state = maybe_schedule_flush(new_state)
      {:noreply, new_state}
    end

    def handle_call(:flush, _from, state) do
      write_events(state.events)
      {:reply, :ok, %{state | events: []}}
    end

    def handle_info(:auto_flush, state) do
      write_events(state.events)
      {:noreply, %{state | events: [], flush_ref: nil}}
    end

    defp sanitize_metadata(meta) when is_map(meta) do
      Map.new(meta, fn {k, v} ->
        {SecureAudit.Sanitizer.clean(to_string(k)),
         SecureAudit.Sanitizer.clean(to_string(v))}
      end)
    end

    defp sanitize_metadata(_), do: %{}

    defp maybe_schedule_flush(%{flush_ref: nil, events: events} = state)
         when length(events) >= 5 do
      ref = Process.send_after(self(), :auto_flush, 100)
      %{state | flush_ref: ref}
    end

    defp maybe_schedule_flush(state), do: state

    defp write_events([]), do: :ok

    defp write_events(events) do
      events
      |> Enum.reverse()
      |> Enum.each(&log_event/1)
    end

    defp log_event(event) do
      meta_str = format_metadata(event.metadata)
      Logger.info(
        "[AUDIT] user=#{event.user_id} action=#{event.action} #{meta_str} ts=#{event.timestamp}"
      )
    end

    defp format_metadata(meta) do
      meta
      |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} -> "#{k}=#{v}" end)
      |> Enum.join(" ")
    end
  end

  defmodule WebHandler do
    @doc "Handles incoming HTTP audit requests"
    def handle_request(%{params: params, headers: headers}) do
      user_id = Map.get(params, "user_id", "anonymous")
      action = Map.get(params, "action", "unknown")
      ip_addr = get_client_ip(headers)
      user_agent = Map.get(headers, "user-agent", "unknown")

      metadata = %{
        "ip" => ip_addr,
        "user_agent" => user_agent,
        "request_id" => Map.get(params, "request_id", generate_request_id())
      }

      # Validate and record
      case validate_action(action) do
        :ok ->
          EventStore.record_event(user_id, action, metadata)
          {:ok, 202, "Event recorded"}

        {:error, reason} ->
          Logger.warning("Invalid audit request: #{SecureAudit.Sanitizer.clean(reason)}")
          {:error, 400, "Invalid request"}
      end
    end

    defp get_client_ip(headers) do
      Map.get(headers, "x-forwarded-for", Map.get(headers, "x-real-ip", "127.0.0.1"))
    end

    defp validate_action(action) when byte_size(action) > 0 and byte_size(action) < 100, do: :ok
    defp validate_action(_), do: {:error, "action field invalid or too long"}

    defp generate_request_id do
      :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(8) |> Base.hex_encode32(case: :lower) |> binary_part(0, 12)
    end
  end
end
